purpose: Large real-Airflow sample for an end-to-end AIV run
sampling: Latest N created per month, one search page, after dropping oversized diffs. Disclosure queries match a filled Generated-by trailer. Not a census. April, September, and October 2026 Claude rows were re-queried by splitting ranges after a zero-hit search.

methodology.objective_slop: Patch text matched AIV hard markers. expect_hard_fail true.
methodology.ai_disclosed: Checkbox yes or Generated-by filled with a real tool. expect_hard_fail false.
methodology.merged_control: Merged, disclosure unfilled, no hard markers. Hard fail = false positive.
methodology.closed_unmerged_sample: Closed unmerged without disclosure or markers. Not slop ground truth.
not_claimed: Filled disclosure does not mean the PR should fail.
This sample is not the fraction of all Airflow PRs that are AI-authored.
Search totals for Generated-by include only the sampled months' reported totals, not a scored census.
